lines.text:
Hi, I'm Quiry! I'm supposed to be joining the A.C.P.U...
Wait, is this not where it is?
Hmm... is that you, Commander?

I'm a Nikke but my eyesight isn't too great. 
Pretty weird, huh?
I can see you as clear as day now, Commander!

Now that I can see you better,
I feel like my surroundings are all a blur.

Having poor eyesight has its advantages.
It means that all I can see is you.

Commander? Are you there?
Where'd you go?

My world is all a haze when you're not here.
This is a recent development, though.
I've almost memorized the way to the Outpost.

There are so many things in the world that look like Poli. 
... Especially towels.
Hmmm? What is this?
Hmm... Is someone there?

Ohh! 
I feel like I can see a litttttle bit more in front of me!
This should let me help Poli out more.
I've gotta keep doing my best!

Wow, thank you...
But what exactly is it?

Wh-what is this?! 
It's got a funny shape...
Thanks, I'll put it to good use!
You're so dazzling, Commander!

Hmmm... Did you get more clear,
or has the world gotten more blurry?
I have the utmost respect for you, Commander. I honestly do.
I'll try my best!
Did you call?
Is this... the right way?
I think I discovered a Rapture!
Firing!
Everything in front of us are Raptures, right?
Where are the Raptures?
Reloading!
Preparing to reload.
Was it this way?
I saw something sparkle!
What a bunch of annoying bugs.
I can see clearly now!
Which way next?
Did I kill it?
Nice!
Agh!
Eeep!
Keuk...!
I didn't see that Rapture on the left...
I could do this with my eyes closed.
